## Reproduction

Provide a sanitized reproduction when possible. Simulated systems, toy projects, generic tag names, and documentation links are preferred.

## Public sources

If the correction is vendor-specific, please link public vendor documentation, manuals, public API docs, open-source vendor repositories, or another public source that supports it.

## Confidentiality check

Before submitting, confirm that this issue does **not** contain customer names, identifying project details, real site IP addresses or hostnames, credentials, certificates, proprietary code, private process data, internal-only vendor documentation, or other confidential information.
